cardSubtitle: Sign in with your device's fingerprint, face, PIN or a security key instead of typing a password. Each passkey is a separate credential; you can register several.
unsupported: This browser or connection can't use passkeys. Open this page over HTTPS in a current browser to manage them. Your password sign-in is not affected.
totpHint: Two-factor authentication is on, so a current code is required.
reauthHint: Adding or removing a passkey asks for your current password{{totp}} so a left-open session can't be used to enrol someone else's device.
registerCancelled: Passkey setup was cancelled. Nothing was added.
removeHint: You can still sign in with your password. Enter your current password to confirm.
mustChangePw: Change your password first, then you can add a passkey.
limit: You can register up to 10 passkeys.
mfaNote: Signing in with a passkey counts as both factors and does not ask for an authenticator code. Password sign-in still does.
loginCancelled: Passkey sign-in was cancelled. You can try again or use your password.
loginFailed: Passkey sign-in failed. Try again, or use your password.
loginUnsupported: Passkeys aren't available in this browser. Use your password instead.
